description: Source code for a Detectron2-based object detection model implementing DETR with segmentation capabilities, including classes for backbone wrapping and the main Detr model with training and inference methods.

classes.name: MaskedBackbone
classes.description: Wrapper around Detectron2 backbone to provide padding masks for feature maps.

classes.name: Detr
classes.description: Main DETR object detection model class with training and inference logic, supporting segmentation.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs a forward pass; computes losses during training or generates detection results during inference.

methods.name: prepare_targets
methods.description: Prepares ground truth targets for training, normalizing boxes and masks.

methods.name: inference
methods.description: Generates detection results from model outputs, including bounding boxes, class labels, scores, and masks.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Normalizes and batches input images for the model.
